title: The Body-Cosmos and the Captive Soul
summary: The cosmos read as the body of a great captive man and the body read as a microcosm of the cosmos: the cosmic body with its five watch-stations (Pherrokatochos, King of Honor, Adamas of Light, King of Glory, Omophoros); Adam molded from the bones of the Watchers' children, Sin rooted in his frame until the Mind of Light is fashioned within; and the twelvefold binding and release of the soul's faculties in the body's somatic substrates by inverse exchange with Sin's counter-faculties.
organizing_principle: Microcosm-macrocosm correspondence as the field of regeneration: the cosmos shaped as a body, the body shaped as a cosmos, with the soul bound and released through faculty-by-faculty exchange between the proprium and the regenerate self.
